pages.page_text: Executive Summary: In March 2024, threat actors associated with APT28 exploited CVE-2023-38831 to deliver payloads. Initial C2 communication reached out to 198.51.100.45 and secondary nodes at evil-update[.]org.
Technical Analysis: Payloads identified include backdoor.exe (SHA256: d2d2d2d2d2d2d2d2d2d2d2d2d2d2d2d2d2d2d2d2d2d2d2d2d2d2d2d2d2d2d2d2). The dropper contacted hxxps://badsite[.]com/api/beacon.
